result.description: LunarKite Nimbus 27 is a fictional 27-inch studio display designed for color-critical illustration, editing, and office productivity. It features a 3840x2160 IPS panel, 99% DCI-P3 coverage, factory calibration, and a matte anti-glare coating for comfortable long-session viewing. Connectivity includes USB-C with display, data, and power passthrough, plus DisplayPort and HDMI inputs. The monitor emphasizes crisp text, accurate color, and flexible desk setup rather than gaming-focused refresh rates or enterprise storage workloads.
result.title: LunarKite Nimbus 27 4K Studio Display
